whenToUse: You show a verified comparison price together with the price that applies now.
whenNotToUse: Products whose reference price is hard to verify, or benefits already included in the sale price.

alternatives.name: Pricing Plan Comparison
alternatives.reason: Comparing the prices of different plans rather than a discount on one product.

accessibility: Tell the reference price and sale price apart with text labels, and don't convey meaning with strikethrough or color alone.
